jobs.title: Sales Project Staff
jobs.description: The Sales Project Staff is in charge of accurately encoding and processing purchase orders, monitoring order status, and providing administrative support to ensure smooth sales operations. The role serves as a key point of coordination between customers and internal departments by responding to inquiries, tracking deliveries, and ensuring that all purchase order records are updated accurately and in a timely manner. Key Responsibilities Accurately encode and process purchase orders in the company's system. Monitor the status of purchase orders and ensure timely updates. Respond promptly and professionally to sales team's emails and inquiries. Coordinate with various departments regarding order status, delivery schedules, and customer concerns. Maintain organized and accurate records of transactions and documentation. Verify information entered into the system to ensure accuracy and completeness. By submitting your application, you expressly agree, consent, and authorize the Company to collect, process, store, share/transfer and retain the Personal Data for any of the purposes stated in this Notice and in accordance with the Data Privacy Act. You may view the Privacy Notice for Job Applicants of Monde Nissin Corporation by requesting it from the hiring manager.

As a Vendor Management Manager, you'll help the organization achieve greater value from its supplier relationships while strengthening procurement governance, cost efficiency, and operational controls. Working closely with the Group Financial Controller and business units, you'll contribute to effective purchasing decisions, reliable supplier performance, and transparent vendor management practices across the organization. What Business Outcomes the Role is Responsible for: Drive Procurement Excellence & Cost Efficiency: Deliver value through effective procurement reviews, supplier negotiations, cost benchmarking, and spend analysis while ensuring timely purchasing decisions and adherence to internal controls. Strengthen Supplier Governance & Performance: Build a reliable and compliant supplier network through effective accreditation, due diligence, related-party screening, and performance monitoring that minimize risks and support quality service delivery. Enhance Contract Management & Operational Efficiency: Ensure accurate, secure, and accessible contract records, proactive renewal monitoring, and efficient documentation processes that strengthen accountability and business continuity.

jobs.title: Clinic Operations Support Nurse
jobs.description: Job Overview The 24/7 Clinic Operations Support Nurse will be MedGrocer's 24/7 lifeline for the medical staff deployed to their client accounts. When office teams are offline, you are the person the nurses and doctors call for urgent concerns, the one who rallies on-shift doctors during emergencies, and the one who keeps every account informed with a clear end-of-shift report. Between escalations, you reach out proactively: checking in on medical staff, gathering their feedback, following up on compliance gaps, and making sure new information reaches everyone before or after the end of their shift. Key responsibilities: 1. Urgent escalations Serve as the primary 24/7 lifeline to support medical staff during medical escalations and emergencies. Serve as the channel for medical staff to escalate urgent concerns, assessing each one and deciding the right next step. Escalate the most urgent issues to Medical Services Leads, following the escalation protocol. Maintain and use a directory of Medical Doctors on shift for each account, calling them for support during medical emergencies. 2. Proactive outreach Conduct regular check-ins with medical staff, measuring eNPS (0–10) on overall job satisfaction: Gather actionable feedback on work environment, peers, MedGrocer and on the client account. Solicit clinic endorsements and file tickets on behalf of medical staff for concerns they raise. Drive compliance by actively following up on delays from medical staff, including but not limited to: Inventory reports Consult logs Documentary and certification requirements Training attendance Test medical staff knowledge and cascade new information, protocols, and updates to them. 3. Shift reporting Submit an end-of-shift report detailing outreach results, compliance gaps, and escalations using the provided template. Conduct clear, seamless handovers of open cases and pending follow-ups to the incoming support team.

jobs.title: Tax Analyst
jobs.description: Position Summary: The Tax Analyst manages ensuring accurate and timely tax compliance, including the preparation and filling of national and local tax returns. This role involves tax reconciliation, liaising with the BIR and other government agencies, and supporting audits to ensure adherence to Philippine tax laws. The position provides tax advisory support, assists in risk assessment, and contribute to strategic tax planning initiatives. What You'll Do: Tax Compliance: Maintain compliance with BIR requirements and ensure timely payment of tax dues and monitor tax refunds. Tax Reporting: Prepare and file monthly, quarterly, and annual tax returns (WTC, VAT, Expanded, Final and Income Tax) accurately and on time. Tax Reconciliation: Gather, validate, and reconcile tax-related data to support accurate reporting. Data Management: Maintain organized documentation for tax filings, audits, and compliance records. Audit Support: Assist in preparing documents for BIR audits and internal and external financial audits. Tax Advisory: Identify tax risks, exposures, and opportunities for corrective action. Process Improvement: Recommend process improvements to streamline tax compliance and documentation.
